⚖️ Responsible AI.title: Cmpnd Releases dspy-wsp: Weight-Space Programming Comes to DSPy
⚖️ Responsible AI.summary: Cmpnd released dspy-wsp, a prototype DSPy optimizer for weight-space programming. A frontier LLM reads a small model’s weights, edits them in a sandbox, and tests each change, with no gradients and about $5 to $10 per run. The post Cmpnd Releases dspy-wsp: Weight-Space Programming Comes to DSPy appeared first on MarkTechPost .

⚖️ Responsible AI.title: Stanford Research Open-Sources Memorilla, a Latent Memory Module for Frozen LLMs
⚖️ Responsible AI.summary: Stanford researchers released Memorilla, an open-source memory system that compresses a document collection into 16 memory tokens for a frozen Qwen3-8B. It reaches 84.33% on FactKG using 108x fewer document tokens than full context. The post Stanford Research Open-Sources Memorilla, a Latent Memory Module for Frozen LLMs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
